editorialSummary: Nothing says humanity is hitting its stride quite like global [climate talks collapsing](https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/arteseideas/cop31-avances-tecnicos-politicos-abren-camino-rumbo-bonn-africa-20261126-846013.html) without a deal while faulty routers trigger [nationwide flight cancellations](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/epoca/noticia/2026/11/25/investigadores-reproduzem-falha-que-suspendeu-voos-nos-eua-e-apontam-possivel-problema-em-roteador-veja-o-que-se-sabe.ghtml) and [autonomous AI agents](https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/tecnologia/agentes-ia-utilizaron-5-ciberataques-suiza-20261126-845961.html) launch cyberattacks. Fortunately, astronomers analyzing a [stadium-sized asteroid crater](https://news.sky.com/story/stadium-sized-crater-left-in-asteroid-after-nasas-planetary-protection-test-13616510) have confirmed that smashing into space rocks remains entirely on schedule.
